sql_generation_plans.application: For each patient record, calculate the deviation of <Laboratory.TP> from the normal index.
steps: Retrieve the <Laboratory.TP> value from <Laboratory.TP>.
Subtract the constant normal index 8.5 from <Laboratory.TP>.

nodes.name: percentage of female who has abnormal prothrombin time (PT)
nodes.description: The percentage of patients older than 55 who are female and have an abnormal prothrombin time (PT >= 14), calculated as the count of such patients divided by the total count of patients older than 55, multiplied by 100.

properties.pattern: Percentage of female patients with abnormal <Laboratory.PT> among patients older than 55.

expression.expr: CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ${PT} >= 14 AND ${SEX} = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)

sql_generation_plans.application: Calculate the percentage for patients selected by age.
steps: Join <Patient> and <Laboratory> on <Patient.ID> = <Laboratory.ID>.
Select patients based on their age derived from <Patient.Birthday>.
Count the total number of selected patients.
Count the subset of selected patients where <Laboratory.PT> is at least 14 and <Patient.SEX> is 'F'.
Divide the subset count by the total count and multiply by 100.
